newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes says 8-month sales up 10 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes says 8-month sales up 10 percent.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG Chief Executive Helmut Werner said Monday that the group's vehicle sales from January to August rose 10 percent to 423,000 units.
Werner also said he believed Mercedes, part of the Daimler-Benz industrial group, would fulfil its planning for 1996 and was optimistic for developments in the second half of the year.

He told a company news conference that he saw essentially little change in the truck market but said that positive response to the new "Actros" heavy truck was expected to provide positive impulses for the European market.
Mercedes said its transport vehicle sales in Europe through the end of August rose 26 percent to 81,000 vehicles.
